# Unified Decoupled Global Kernel monthly dispatcher (called ONCE per month globally).
# Preserves every existing global_var:oe_*_ran_m / oe_*_ran_y deduplication guard so
# BYZ's oe_clock_mainline (Slots 1-98) NEVER double-fires when active, while all 22
# consolidated fallback pulses continue working seamlessly if BYZ falls or on non-1337 starts.
oe_gk_monthly_dispatch = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_gk_init } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_gk_init value = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_gk_tick_count value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_gk_q_count value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_gk_y_count value = 0 }
	}
	change_global_variable = { name = oe_gk_tick_count add = 1 }

	# v15.0 Scheme B safety net: if Great Yuan (CHI) loses both Dadu and Shangdu while
	# Lingbei (YLB) is still its subject holding Karakorum, return Karakorum to CHI so
	# vanilla flavor_chi.38 ("Fleeing to Karakorum") fires seamlessly with zero vanilla override.
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = c:CHI
			country_exists = c:YLB
			c:CHI = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { owns = location:dadu }
				NOT = { owns = location:shangdu }
			}
			c:YLB = {
				is_subject_of = c:CHI
				owns = location:karakorum
			}
		}
		location:karakorum = { change_location_owner = c:CHI }
	}

	# --- A. Bookmark-agnostic self-deduplicating global engines (work on 1337 & future bookmarks) ---

	# 1. Chagatai 1347 Split & Eurasian Building Governors (oe_eug)
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_eug_ran_m ?= oe_eug_m_now } }
		oe_eug_monthly = yes
	}

	# 2. Far Seas & Overseas Exarchates (oe_far — requires Roman host scope)
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_far_ran_m ?= oe_far_m_now } }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:ROM c:ROM = { is_rebel_country = no } }
			c:ROM = { oe_far_monthly = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { is_rebel_country = no } }
			c:BYZ = { oe_far_monthly = yes }
		}
	}

	# 3. 12-Major Dynamic Anti-Hegemon AI Global Cache (oe_heg_ai)
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_heg_ai_ran_m ?= oe_heg_ai_m_now } }

	}

	# 4. Imperial Culture Fusion & Dynamic Institution Origins (oe_cul)
	if = {

			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_cul_ran_m }

	# 8. Unified Empire Entropy Anti-Snowball Engine (oe_ent — per eligible large empire, self-deduplicated via var:oe_ent_ran_m)
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			is_rebel_country = no

			NOT = { var:oe_ent_ran_m ?= oe_ent_m_now }

# Quarterly global dispatcher (months 1 / 4 / 7 / 10).
oe_gk_quarterly_dispatch = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_gk_q_count } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_gk_q_count value = 0 }
	}
	change_global_variable = { name = oe_gk_q_count add = 1 }

	# Keep Multipolar High-Tension Eurasia modifier refreshed on all non-subject great powers & players.
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_v150_preset_multipolar }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				is_subject = no
				OR = {
					is_great_power = yes
					is_ai = no
				}
			}
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_v150_preset_multipolar_mod
				years = 2
				mode = replace
			}
		}
	}
}

	# 21. Observer Telemetry 1.0 (Slot 88, oe_bal — Rule #16 default OFF)
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_bal_rule_is_on = yes
			current_month = 1
			NOT = { global_var:oe_bal_ran_y ?= current_year }
		}
		oe_bal_monthly = yes

	# 22. Cross-Wave Telemetry 2.0 (v14.0, oe_bal2 — Rule #16 default OFF)

		oe_bal2_emit_extended_snapshot = yes

# Yearly entropy & crisis tension nudge when Hardcore Gauntlet preset is active.
oe_v150_preset_hardcore_yearly_tick = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_subject = no
			OR = {
				is_ai = no
				num_locations >= 100
				has_variable = oe_ent_index
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_v150_preset_hardcore_mod
			years = 2
			mode = replace
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_ent_index }
			change_variable = { name = oe_ent_index add = 2 }
			clamp_variable = { name = oe_ent_index min = 0 max = 100 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_tension }
		change_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_tension add = 2 }
		clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_tension min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
}

# Cleanly resets all v15.0 challenge preset flags & modifiers (used on switch or dev test).
oe_v150_preset_clear_all = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_v150_preset_standard } remove_global_variable = oe_v150_preset_standard }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_v150_preset_multipolar } remove_global_variable = oe_v150_preset_multipolar }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_v150_preset_hardcore } remove_global_variable = oe_v150_preset_hardcore }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_v150_preset_elysia_fast } remove_global_variable = oe_v150_preset_elysia_fast }
	every_country = {
		if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v150_preset_multipolar_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_v150_preset_multipolar_mod }
		if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v150_preset_hardcore_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_v150_preset_hardcore_mod }
		if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v150_preset_elysia_fast } remove_country_modifier = oe_v150_preset_elysia_fast }
	}
}
